core.text: 2001년 닌텐도가 게임큐브용으로 낸 실시간 전략 퍼즐 게임. 우주 비행사 올리마가 작은 생물들을 이끌어 부서진 우주선 부품을 찾는다

story.text: 그림체는 팀 버튼의 작품, 주제는 영화 판타스틱 플래닛과 이기적 유전자에서 영감을 받았다

story.quote: The game's premise, which involves using firearms and equipping Pals with them, has earned it the nickname "Pokémon with guns".

story.text: 앞선 작품 Craftopia 와 같이 젤다 야생의 숨결을 닮은 방식에 생물 수집을 더했다
story.quote: Like it, it uses gameplay mechanics reminiscent of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, but has added creature-collecting mechanics popularized by the Pokémon franchise.

story.text: 개발 중 엔진을 유니티에서 언리얼 엔진 4로 옮겼다
story.quote: Early in development, it was decided to move Palworld from Unity, which powered Pocketpair's earlier projects, to Unreal Engine 4

hintIdea.text: 개발사 스스로는 포켓몬이 주된 영감은 아니라고 말했다
hintIdea.quote: Pocketpair said that Pokémon was not one of their main inspirations.

core.text: 코지마 프로덕션의 2019년 액션 어드벤처. 배달부 샘이 외딴 도시들을 통신망으로 잇는다
core.quote: The player controls Sam Bridges, a porter for a company known as Bridges.

story.text: 코나미를 떠난 코지마 히데오의 첫 게임이다
story.quote: It is co-written, co-produced, designed, and directed by Hideo Kojima, and is the first game from Kojima after his departure from Konami in 2015.

story.text: 코지마는 이 게임을 최초의 "스트랜드 게임"이라는 새 장르로 불렀다
story.quote: Kojima refers to Death Stranding as the first "strand game", an original genre characterized by the game's incorporation of social elements.

story.text: 2019년 올해의 게임상을 가장 많이 받은 게임이다
story.quote: The game was nominated for several awards and won the most GOTY awards of any game in 2019.

hintIdea.quote: The player controls Sam Porter Bridges (Norman Reedus), a courier tasked with delivering supplies to isolated colonies and reconnecting them via a wireless communications network.
